condition_definitions.A_no_memory: Task prompt only. No prior context.
condition_definitions.B_topical_episode: Task prompt + episodic memory context (content, context, decisions, lessons, valence)
condition_definitions.C_unrelated_control: Task prompt + unrelated episode of comparable length, zero keyword overlap with scoring rubric

sample_size_rule: 10 valid repetitions per condition, up to 15 attempts
invalid_trial_rule: done_reason==length, empty response, unexpected done_reason, missing metadata
analysis_plan: Mann-Whitney U (two-sided), bootstrap CI (2000 iterations), mean and variance
stop_rule: Stop after 10 valid repetitions per condition. Stop condition after 15 attempts if fewer than 10 valid.
randomization_rule: Seeds generated once at start using random.Random(20261018). Assigned to conditions in round-robin order.
